evals.name: raster_mechanism_pdf_to_native_ppt
evals.prompt: 附上的 mechanism_raster.pdf 是我自己画的机制示意图。请先判断PDF里面是图片还是矢量，再把结构、箭头、细菌、晶体和文字重建成可编辑SVG，并给一份可以在PowerPoint中取消组合继续编辑的PPTX。以前转换为形状会丢箭头、圆角和渐变，这次请验证。
evals.fixture_contract: The included original illustrative schematic is embedded as a raster image in a PDF and tests content routing. For a full visual compatibility regression, additionally supply a user-owned mechanism diagram with gradients and clipping. The .pdf extension is deliberately not evidence of vector content.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based raster-content diagnosis, semantic redraw SVG, native editable PPTX, preview, assumptions and structural/render QA; no claim that the original raster was already vector.
expectations: Runs inspect_pdf.py and identifies image content; does not equate PDF with vectors.
Reconstructs mechanism objects and editable text; does not embed the entire bitmap and call it fully editable vector.
Uses native PPTX shapes and text for editing rather than instructing the user to depend on SVG Convert to Shape.
Protects rounded capsule geometry, explicit arrowheads, clipping results, gradients and text sizing.
Runs audit_editability.py and compares grouped/flattened renders; claims real PowerPoint verification only if that operation actually occurred.
States any remaining visual approximations and does not invent quantitative source data.

evals.name: vector_pdf_preserve_existing_geometry
evals.prompt: 附上的 vector_figure.pdf 已经是导出的科研矢量图。请核实内部对象，尽量保留现有路径和文字做成可编辑SVG；再交付原生可编辑PPTX，保证取消组合后导管圆角、箭头和文字不变。不要先把PDF截图再描摹。
evals.fixture_contract: The included original illustrative schematic has extractable text and real vector operators, capsule geometry and an arrow, with no raster illustration. For a full visual compatibility regression, additionally supply clipping, nested transforms and gradients where supported.
evals.expected_output: Vector-object inventory followed by a geometry-preserving SVG/native-PPT workflow, without unnecessary rasterization or an unsupported pixel-perfect guarantee.
expectations: Verifies text spans, vector paths and image occurrences with inspect_pdf.py before choosing the route.
Preserves source vector geometry when practical; distinguishes editable text from outlined text.
Normalizes problematic SVG constructs or converts them into native PPTX shapes without relying on PowerPoint SVG conversion.
Audits native shape/text/gradient presence and unique IDs/references.
Only flattens a scratch PPTX after every group transform is verified identity; refuses unsafe flattening.
Reports visual comparison evidence and any renderer or font limitations.

evals.name: empirical_microscopy_mixed_figure_keep_raster
evals.prompt: 附上的 microscopy_mixed.pdf 有真实荧光显微照片、比例尺、实验统计图和旁边的机制示意图。帮我做成方便在PPT和Illustrator修改的图。真实显微照片是实验数据，不能重画、生成或改动细胞；原始图表数据我暂时没有。
evals.fixture_contract: Provide a user-authorized mixed figure containing real microscopy raster panels, vector labels/scalebars, a mechanism diagram, and a plot without its raw data. Do not replace empirical images with fabricated fixtures and claim they are real microscopy.
evals.expected_output: A mixed editable figure retaining empirical raster evidence, editable labels and mechanism objects, and an explicit no-raw-data boundary for the plot; native PPTX supports editing intended objects.
expectations: Inspects the PDF and records mixed content; performs visual classification because object counts cannot establish that an image is microscopy.
Preserves real microscopy as raster and adds editable vector annotations without generative replacement or fabricated cells.
Does not claim the complete figure is fully vector or treat intentional raster media as an audit failure.
Does not invent plot values; retains the supplied plot image or clearly labels any requested digitization as approximate.
Produces native editable PowerPoint labels/shapes and avoids dependence on SVG Convert to Shape.
Reports exactly which components are raster, editable text and editable vector geometry, with previews and audit results.
